items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week of practice with no setbacks from hamstring; was listed questionable.
items.why: Full practice week, starter reps, no setbacks after missing three games.
items.implication: QB upgrade for CHI pass-catchers vs ATL; solid start candidate.
items.opportunity: Rome Odunze, DJ Moore (if active), others gain from starter QB return.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown to 53-man roster; expected to play Sunday vs Jets after IR stint for high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Practiced this week; activated from IR.
items.implication: Immediate WR2 upside in NE offense vs Jets.
items.opportunity: Primary target share expected; monitors ankle limitations.

items.text: Eagles placing QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve due to blood clot after consultations with doctors; move sidelines him indefinitely. Tanner McKee to start.
items.why: Blood clot in calf; extensive medical consultations Saturday.
items.implication: Indefinite absence; McKee starts, lowers Eagles offense ceiling especially without dual-threat rushing.
items.opportunity: Pass-catchers DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks retain roles but volume may drop; Dameon Pierce leads thin RB room.

items.text: Ravens officially activated WR Ja’Kobi Lane from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Browns.
items.why: Activated from IR, expected to play.
items.implication: Depth WR option in BAL with Lamar out; monitor snaps behind Flowers.
items.opportunity: Potential target share if role expands.

items.text: Pick up Tanner McKee in any league needing QB; will be better than thought. Not worried about any Eagles skill players with McKee. Start AJ Brown if active as WR2.
items.why: McKee can play; skill talent healthy; AJB expected active.
items.implication: McKee streamer; Eagles weapons viable; AJB immediate start.
items.opportunity: PHI pass-catchers maintain; AJB targets vs NYJ.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren Friday Q add (groin). Probables lean: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so heavy 2-WR Metcalf + Bernard. PHI McKee has 4th-string RB Pierce but healthy top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon).
items.why: Practice/report reading; PIT depth chart thinness; PHI personnel.
items.implication: Metcalf heavy usage in 2-WR; PHI pass-catchers safer than RBs with McKee; monitor unclear Qs closely.
items.opportunity: DK Metcalf target/route share spike; DeVonta/Goedert stable; Henderson doubt for high-ankle.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Sunday.
items.why: Ankle injury; official ETR Sunday list.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts; downgrade BAL pass game, Flowers still viable WR2.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers maintains targets; Andrews less appealing.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT along with Jalen Hurts and Will Shipley.
items.implication: Dameon Pierce leads PHI backfield behind McKee; thin RB room.
NYJ RB committee or backup lead; downgrade Jets run game.

items.opportunity: Increased carries for remaining HOU RBs.

items.implication: KC WR targets redistribute to Worthy/others.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4) due to Commanders defense nightmare for WRs.
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone potential vs weak secondary.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) for bankable usage.
Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage and soft run defense.
items.why: Elite usage lately; ARI leaks vs run.
